description: Rows of PIG-PIB's ArcGIS services hydrogeologia/mwp and hydrogeologia/mwp_auto (ADR-035), cut to eleven points: 6495 (automatic daily bore, Olszyc Szlachecki), 757, 6713, 9312 (automatic), 9830 (automatic, not in mwp_auto's layer 0), 853 (manual weekly bore), 1247 (spring), 1934 (artesian bore), 3 (blank type, not observed), 8269 (no observed flag), 11 (no ground elevation). mwp/MapServer/0 (points, outSR=4326), mwp/MapServer/1 (every October 2026 reading of these points and the one reading of 9390, a point missing from layer 0) and mwp_auto/MapServer/0 (the automatic points) are rows of the probe of 2026-11-24 22:16-22:18 UTC (pages mwp-0-page-*, mwp-1-page-*, mwp_auto-0-page-0000). mwp_auto/MapServer/2 (hourly rows, OBJECTIDs as recorded): stored day 2026-11-23 of 6495, the rows 60920525/60920526 of 9312 (stored hour 2026-11-23 22:00, values 4.81 and 4.809) and 60910332/60923482 of 9830 (one identical row twice, stored hour 2026-11-23 00:00) from the probe's pages of that stored day (2026-11-24 22:18 UTC); stored day 2026-03-29 of 6495 from the backfill harvest of 2026-11-24T23:30:49Z (appended pages 1395 and 1411, OBJECTID > 53586301), whose two rows at 00:00:01Z carry "_stored" from that run's page of the stored hour 02 (55305481 stored 02:00:01, 55289214 stored 01:00:01; every row of that day carries "_stored", never served); stored days 2026-10-15, 2026-10-25 and 2026-10-27 of 757, 2026-10-18 of 6713 and the row 58035369 of point 2405 stored at 2136-02-07 07:28:15 from live POSTs of 2026-11-25 (07:38-07:38 UTC, where by PSH_MONITORING_ID and stored day, and by stored year 2136 for the stray row). head: a recorded page answer without features and exceededTransferLimit.
